initial.chief_complaint: Tired, cold all the time and gaining weight for several months.

presenting_complaint: Tired, cold all the time and gaining weight for several months.
history_freetext:
Over about six months she has felt increasingly tired and cold, gained 5 kg without eating more, has dry skin, hair thinning and constipation. Periods are regular but heavier. Feels low and slow in thinking.
No palpitations, no heat intolerance, no neck pain, no difficulty swallowing, no chest pain, no shortness of breath. No recent illness, no pregnancy planned; uses condoms.
Mother and a maternal aunt take thyroid tablets. No neck radiation, no thyroid surgery, no heart disease, no diabetes. No lithium, no amiodarone.
No regular medication; takes an iron and vitamin tablet occasionally. No known drug allergies.
